title: CakeLow
description: I made JudeLow a Cake for funnys
body:
![JudeLow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1f41ab723a4b07766687aef83289537cff4b888.gif)

Turn your ordinary Minecraft cake into something way more fun with this resource pack! This pack replaces the default cake texture with JudeLow's Face

Perfect for fans of JudeLow or anyone this pack keeps everything vanilla friendly while making cakes stand out!
